plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Duke University's official Psychology department requirements page (psychandneuro.duke.edu) and the official 'Psychology BS Degree New Curriculum Checklist' linked from it (duke.app.box.com), for students matriculating Fall 2026 and Forward. Duke publishes requirements only (no official semester sequence), so this plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single requirements block. Duke uses COURSE UNITS, not semester hours: 1 course = 1 unit (approximately 3-4 semester hours); units below are Duke course units and were NOT converted to semester hours. 34 units total are required for the BS degree. COUNTING RECONCILIATION (the reason this plan was previously held): the department page's introductory sentence says sixteen (16) courses are required, but its own checklist arithmetic is Foundation 3 + Breadth 3 + Electives 5 = 11 psychology courses (the checklist states the additional electives bring 'the total to 11'), plus 5 Quantitative Studies and Natural Science electives from outside departments = 16 total courses. The recorded 16 units follow the checklist arithmetic, and the 5 QS/NS electives are recorded as elective-category slots, not psychology courses. The prior cohort (matriculated Summer 2020 to Spring 2026) counts identically (Foundation 3 + Breadth 3 + Depth/Specialization 5 = 11, + 5 QS/NS = 16) with slightly different breadth/depth wording. Elective rules (new curriculum): at most 2 Independent Study courses (PSY 391-394, 491-495); at most 1 of PSY 232, UNIV 101, UNIV 104; at most 1 additional 100-level breadth course; PSY 203 Practicum does not count toward the major; PSY 391-394 and PSY 491-499 do not count toward the two 300+ level courses. QS/NS rules: the 5 electives come from an approved list, from at least two external departments, at least 3 at or above the 200 level; psychology courses cross-listed with another department do not count as a second department.

courses.title: Breadth: Biological / Cognitive (1 unit, choose one)
courses.choice_note: One of: Biological (NEUROSCI 101 or NEUROSCI 102, PSY 106 or PSY 107) or Cognitive (PSY 102) or Intro to Cognitive Neuroscience (PSY 217).

courses.title: Breadth: Clinical / Developmental / Social (1 unit, choose one)
courses.choice_note: One of: Clinical (PSY 105), Developmental (PSY 103) or Social (PSY 104).

courses.title: Breadth: one additional course from either category (1 unit)
courses.choice_note: One additional course from either breadth category listed above (Biological/Cognitive or Clinical/Developmental/Social).

courses.title: Elective at 300+ level (1 unit, course 1 of 2)
courses.choice_note: Two 300+ level or above courses are required within the 5 elective units. PSY 391-394 and PSY 491-499 do not count toward this requirement.

courses.title: Elective at 300+ level (1 unit, course 2 of 2)
courses.choice_note: Second of the two required 300+ level or above elective courses. PSY 391-394 and PSY 491-499 do not count toward this requirement.

courses.title: Additional psychology elective (1 unit, course 1 of 3)
courses.choice_note: Three additional courses bring the psychology total to 11. At most 2 Independent Study courses (PSY 391-394, 491-495); at most 1 of PSY 232, UNIV 101, UNIV 104; at most 1 additional 100-level breadth course; PSY 203 Practicum does not count.

courses.title: Additional psychology elective (1 unit, course 2 of 3)
courses.choice_note: Additional courses to bring the total to 11; same elective rules as the first additional-course slot.

courses.title: Additional psychology elective (1 unit, course 3 of 3)
courses.choice_note: Additional courses to bring the total to 11; same elective rules as the first additional-course slot.

courses.title: Quantitative Studies / Natural Science elective (1 unit, course 1 of 5)
courses.choice_note: Five QS/NS electives from an approved list: from at least two external departments, at least 3 of the 5 at or above the 200 level; psychology courses cross-listed with another department do not count as a second department.

courses.title: Quantitative Studies / Natural Science elective (1 unit, course 2 of 5)
courses.choice_note: QS/NS elective; same approved-list and department/level criteria as the first QS/NS slot.

courses.title: Quantitative Studies / Natural Science elective (1 unit, course 3 of 5)
courses.choice_note: QS/NS elective; same approved-list and department/level criteria as the first QS/NS slot.

courses.title: Quantitative Studies / Natural Science elective (1 unit, course 4 of 5)
courses.choice_note: QS/NS elective; same approved-list and department/level criteria as the first QS/NS slot.

courses.title: Quantitative Studies / Natural Science elective (1 unit, course 5 of 5)
